खुल्ल mfn. (-ल्लः-ल्ला-ल्लं) Small, little, low, mean, &c.
 n. (-ल्लं) A kind of
perfume: see खुर.
 E. खुद् to divide, &c. and ल from ला to get, the
radical द becomes ल.

खुल्लक mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
 1. Low, vile.
 2. Little, small.
 3. Poor, indigent.
[]
4. Cruel, harsh.
 5. Wicked, mischievous, malignant: see क्षुल्ल.
खुल्लतात m. (-तः) A father's younger brother; also क्षुल्लतात.
